method: Apply the frozen argument unchanged to each declared nearby object, stop at the first missing premise, and distinguish that stop from both a failure of the in-scope theorem and the absence of a different stronger extraction.
failure_signature: If the unchanged proof reaches the scoped generic obstruction after a mandatory premise has been removed, then the argument has survived a known-false transfer and J3 breaks.

controls.minimal_mutation: Replace arbitrary-deck universality with a promise of constant average success only on decks sampled from the solver's random distribution; keep the remaining generic and accounting assumptions unchanged.

first_missing_premise.stage: instantiate the solver on the constructed mixed-radix decks
first_missing_premise.reason: The structured special decks need not lie in the promised distribution, and average random-deck success gives no constant-success guarantee on them.

controls.theorem_effect: none; the in-scope theorem retains A1 and A9
controls.scope_effect: no random-deck-only or P1553-distribution-only lower bound
controls.additional_note: Nonzero or negligible probability that a random sampler emits a special deck would not supply the uniform constant success required by the reduction.

controls.object: solver without subset stability in one deck
controls.minimal_mutation: Retain exact canonical restriction access for four decks but permit only the whole fifth deck in every query.

first_missing_premise.reason: The written L3 recursion cannot split the unrestricted deck and therefore does not end with five singleton occurrence labels.

controls.theorem_effect: none; the in-scope theorem assumes all-five-deck subset stability
controls.scope_effect: the current artifact does not cover this mutation

stronger_extraction_candidate.construction: Isolate the four restriction-stable decks, form the residual group element required from the fifth deck, and scan the public labelled fifth deck for a matching encoding.
stronger_extraction_candidate.asymptotic_increment: Theta(B) public comparisons or at most Theta(B) charged generic work, below B^(5/4+o(1))
stronger_extraction_candidate.limitations: Requires J1 validation of label and collision handling and J2 validation of what equality, preprocessing, replay, and scan costs enter ell and k.
stronger_extraction_candidate.interpretation: The written proof stops, but one-deck non-stability is not established as a permanent safe route.

controls.minimal_mutation: Allow preprocessing state to be chosen after Q or R is known.

first_missing_premise.reason: The crossing information is no longer independent of the fresh DLP challenge, so the declared MPZ preprocessing substitution cannot be invoked.

controls.additional_note: Whether a target-conditioned scheme can actually compute or encode x is irrelevant to this control; the cited premise is already inapplicable.

controls.minimal_mutation: Keep the B^(9/4+o(1)) word count but permit each crossing word to contain unboundedly many bits at unit cost.

first_missing_premise.stage: map crossing storage to ell in L5
first_missing_premise.reason: A word bound no longer supplies ell=B^(9/4+o(1)) advice bits; serialization size can dominate the claimed exponent.

controls.theorem_effect: none; ordinary O(log N)-bit or serialized-bit charging is explicit
controls.scope_effect: no word-RAM, cell-probe, or unbounded-cell lower bound follows merely from the word count
controls.additional_note: The logarithmic conversion is absorbable only after a real bit bound has been supplied.

controls.minimal_mutation: Give the solver coordinates and a Semaev, resultant, or field-arithmetic oracle whose information is not represented by generic-group handles and interactions.

first_missing_premise.stage: type the composed algorithm as an MPZ generic-group algorithm
first_missing_premise.reason: Coordinate and field operations expose representation-specific information outside the generic oracle transcript, so the generic theorem does not bound the composed algorithm.

controls.theorem_effect: none; the theorem remains conditional on exact generic-model applicability
controls.scope_effect: no coordinate-aware EC, Semaev, resultant, or field-oracle lower bound
controls.additional_note: Counting only the object's generic-group calls would omit its load-bearing coordinate information channel.

controls.minimal_mutation: Replace the exact all-five-deck subset existence interface with an output that narrows or identifies only a fifth-deck interval for the frozen target-local P1553 object.

first_missing_premise.stage: invoke L3 adaptive all-five-deck witness isolation
first_missing_premise.reason: The output neither answers the exact restricted existence predicate for every deck nor returns the first four occurrence labels needed by L4.

controls.theorem_effect: none; the in-scope interface remains exact and all-five-deck subset-stable
controls.scope_effect: no lower bound for r_R mod g_I, exact dyadic unit products, or fifth-interval-only P1553 output
additional_missing_boundaries: A1/A9 if the object is promised only on the frozen P1553 distribution
A10 if the construction uses coordinates or field arithmetic

summary.control_design_caveat: PTM3 is a valid stop for unchanged L3 but not a demonstrated maximal boundary because a four-deck isolation plus public fifth-deck scan may extend extraction.

required_order: for every candidate solver satisfying the scoped interface
for all sufficiently large prime orders N
construct the public mixed-radix decks independently of the target
sample fresh uniform x and Q=[x]P
run the adaptive transcript under one aggregate interaction cap
bound success probability over the fresh challenge and generic randomness
forbidden_reorderings: choosing special decks after seeing Q
replacing success on every selected deck family by average success on random decks
turning a random-target success bound into a pointwise bound for one fixed Q

scope_transfer_audit.whole_deck_or_fifth_interval_outputs: preserved by the current proof; recovery interface missing
scope_transfer_audit.target_local_transducer: preserved and explicitly scheduled for continued search
scope_transfer_audit.generic_ECDLP_lower_bound: not claimed; the direction is a DLP bound applied to a typed solver reduction

steering_audit.required_future_guard: Apply the correction only after an exact assumption-by-assumption classifier; do not use the P1553-bearing record name, analogy, or generic subroutine overlap as a proxy for applicability.
steering_audit.successor_candidate: Separately review the four-deck-isolation plus fifth-deck public-scan extractor without broadening the present theorem.
